data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-time Dashboard with Live Metrics
features.description: Showcase real-time metrics using Chart.js graphs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are displayed using an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Utilize Chart.js to create various data visualizations for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts include line, bar, area, pie, and radar types.

features.title: Showcase Real Metrics
features.description: Present real metrics from recent Artemis runs in the demo.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent Artemis runs.
Data is accurate and reflects actual performance.
Metrics are integrated into the presentation seamlessly.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance metrics.
SOLID principles are visualized in the chart.
Metrics are accurate and up-to-date.

features.title: Auto-advance Slides with Navigation
features.description: Implement auto-advancing slides with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages with a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Integration is visualized using a pie chart.
Chart accurately reflects integration data.
Visual representation is clear and informative.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Visual elements are cohesive and aesthetically pleasing.
